items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: And, but there was something in that, that entranced me and captivated me about that music. And of course he's still today the greatest and he and I have run across each other in many cities.

ctx.x: And, but there was something in that, that entranced me and captivated me about that music. And of course he's still today the greatest and he and I have run across each other in many cities. And the last time I saw him, he was in here listening to the band. Oh really? He was in here listening to the band.
Did you ever hear any of the parades on the streets or funerals or anything?
